{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Refined knit top with a crew neck and long sleeves, relaxed fit, heather grey #A9A9A9, fine merino wool blend.
Tailored straight-leg trousers with a mid-rise waist, classic cut, charcoal blue #36454F, heavy crepe fabric.
Structured blazer with notched lapels and a single-breasted button closure, tailored silhouette, navy blue #1C2E4A, structured cotton-blend twill.
Leather ankle boots with a low block heel and a closed toe, rounded shaft, black #000000, smooth calfskin leather with a salt-resistant finish.

This outfit perfectly balances the need for professional polish while ensuring total comfort for walking to work in snowy and frosty conditions. The heavy crepe trousers and wool knit provide warmth against the cold without restricting movement, respecting her refusal to wear open zones or heels that might be unsafe on salted sidewalks. A blazer adds the required neat business layer for a work setting, while the closed-toe ankle boots protect her feet from wet snow and slush without compromising her desire to avoid exposed ankles. The dark, solid colors create a streamlined silhouette that hides any minor distractions of walking briskly while maintaining a sophisticated look."}
